answer: Every identity in this economy is a slow-burning lantern: it takes many epochs of honest work to light, so an attacker who would wander in with a thousand fresh keys starts each one cold and dark. Attestation rewards only the lit lamp - a pearl formed grain by grain, never minted on request. Cloning a wallet is free; cloning its history is not, so running sybils at scale costs epochs he cannot buy back once burned.
